title: Blue Hair Karen Realizes Actions Have Consequences
description:
A confrontation over a MAGA hat at a Florida dog park leads to an explosive arrest. Watch as the suspect, Laura Garrett, 33, is arrested after allegedly attacking a 72-year-old man over a politically-charged argument sparked by a hat. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
